question: Does counting work as leaves returned (shape-independent) instead of nodes visited, calibrated to the same limit-hit rate, route at least as well as P04.1's canonical arm?

canonical.engine: freerouting-rs P04 working tree on 93c326f (release), the CLI
canonical.command: freerouting-dev bench --set tools/bench/sets/p04.txt --rust <wrapper> --runs 1 --max-load off --timeout 7200 --out <dir> (Rust only; the wrapper runs the release CLI of the P04 build with the arm's settings and --stats json; bounds from tools/java-reference/route-bounds.tsv; the optimizer off, bench's default)

settings.everything else: bench's command line and the route bounds

canonical-leaves.engine: freerouting-rs P04 working tree on 93c326f (release), the CLI
canonical-leaves.command: freerouting-dev bench --set tools/bench/sets/p04.txt --rust <wrapper> --runs 1 --max-load off --timeout 7200 --out <dir> (Rust only; the wrapper runs the release CLI of the P04 build with the arm's settings and --stats json; bounds from tools/java-reference/route-bounds.tsv; the optimizer off, bench's default)

settings.everything else: bench's command line and the route bounds

boards.dsn: the 16 benchmark boards and the five in-repository canary-pwr variants (one board for the pass rule: gate collect --group fixtures/canary-pwr/=canary-pwr)

eligibility: every board of the set; no board is dropped after a number exists. A board both arms leave with equal unrouted is neutral and printed.
grading: Freerouting's board model through bench (ses-diff statistics) and gate collect's via_in_pad on every board; KiCad's DRC (F02.6, tools/kicad-oracle/grade-set.sh, KiCad 10.0.7 WSL) on the KiCad demos ecc83, interf_u, kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213 and sonde and on canary-pwr (rev1.0 .kicad_pcb), each arm with --router.autorouter.max_passes=5 --router.optimizer.enabled=false: drc_real and unconnected are reported per arm as a second table and drc_real is a guard (a board whose drc_real rises is a regression for the decision below)

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: gate collect: vias whose copper overlaps an SMD pad on the imported SES, minus those in the input
metric_definitions.clearance_violations: bench statistics (ses-diff's import): clearance violations of the routed board
metric_definitions.unrouted: bench statistics: incomplete connections of the routed board
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: bench median wall time (one run, load 3-8: not comparable)

keep_rule: P04.2's rule: the same as P04.1's, against P04.1's canonical arm; leaves becomes the default work unit with its own DIVERGENCES line. Calibration (before this arm runs): LEAF_UNITS_PER_NOMINAL_MS = 64,000 x (tree_leaves_returned / tree_nodes_visited) summed over the canonical arm's --stats json on the whole set, rounded to 1,000; the number of connections and fanout pins hitting a work limit (maze_work_limit_hits + fanout_work_limit_hits) must be within 5 % of the canonical arm's (or equal when that is below 20).
stop_rule: one run per board and arm (routing is deterministic, D2); a crash or timeout is re-run once and reported
